title: a diss track on enchiladas
body:
you disgust me.
you're like a burrito but less
and a taquito but more.

you know how goldilocks has to
pick between the three soups and
the middle one is just right?

you're straight wrong.
always overpriced, never filling enough,
forever a retching cylinder of
stubborn cheese and fishy chicken.

how the FUCK

did you find yourself at this cantina?
